title: Schild contracts v0: shared definitions
description: Regex rules for every schema in contracts/: ECMA-262 semantics, ASCII only, no \d \w \s, no lookaround, no backreferences. `$` means end of string (the Python cross-check translates it to \Z).

timestamp.description: UTC timestamp, whole seconds, always with Z.

timestampMillis.description: UTC timestamp with optional fraction (local events only).

timeBucket.description: Start of a 5-minute bucket (5, 10 or 15 minute buckets all start on a multiple of 5 minutes).

uuid.description: Random UUID v4, lowercase. Never derived from site, visitor or key material.

id.description: Lowercase identifier for labs, operators, issuers, relays, channels.

keyid.description: Key identifier. Test keys start with `test-` and are rejected by release builds.

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key, standard base64 with padding.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case; ZZ = unknown.

asn.description: Autonomous system number; 0 = unknown. At most 2^24 - 1: covers every ASN IANA has delegated (well below 1,000,000 in 2026) and rules out an IPv4 address written as an integer.

attribution.description: Where the client address came from (G5). Anything else never produces a signal.

noLeak.description: Free-text tokens that leave the server must not look like an address or an opaque blob: no dotted or dashed IPv4, no dashed IPv6, no run of 7+ digits (IPv4 as integer), no run of 8+ hex digits (hashes, hex-encoded addresses). Lower-case hex only; tokens that use it are lower case.

safeToken.description: Lowercase token without spaces, colons, query characters or anything address-like (noLeak).

matchShape.description: Shape of a WAF match without content (G4): where, which content type, how long.
